title: The first back
logline: The first page with him in it since January: a back on the seawall, the blue plaid, the pup beside him. The sequence opens. Nothing else.

panels.composition: The seawall in June, and on it, from behind, a man sitting with his boots over the edge, blue plaid flannel, hair going gray, a small three-legged dog sitting beside him. The bay. The page holds on the back and gives no more.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a man seen from behind sitting on a concrete seawall with his boots over the edge in blue plaid flannel with graying hair, a small three-legged dog sitting beside him, a bay beyond, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
